**Chinese name:** 上海燧原科技股份有限公司 (Shànghǎi Suìyuán Kējì Gǔfèn Yǒuxiàn Gōngsī)

::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Founded March 2018 by two former AMD engineers; completed a near-$900 million Shanghai STAR Market IPO, one of the larger domestic AI-chip listings to date.
:::

## What does this firm design?

AI training and inference accelerators (branded GCUs) for cloud compute, with an accompanying software stack.
